title: SK Nefro Báza 1 Compendium
author: Ľubomír Polaščín, MD
description: English edition of abstracts and summaries of 387 specialist articles from nefro.polascin.net, in 16 chapters and an appendix. A map of the full SK Nefro Báza 1: key figures, limits of the evidence and a practical conclusion. Period from 25 April 2026 to 2 October 2026. Intended for health professionals; it does not replace clinical judgment.
